adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff in handleNewBooking.ts, the code at line 1077 shows `if (isTeamEventType && eventType.schedulingType === 'COLLECTIVE') { evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars); }`. The `evt.destinationCalendar` is set earlier (around line 1043-1047) as either `[eventType.destinationCalendar]`, `[organizerUser.destinationCalendar]`, or `null`. When it's `null`, the optional chaining `?.push()` will silently do nothing, meaning `teamDestinationCalendars` (which contains co-host calendars for collective events) will be dropped. This is a real bug - for collective team events where neither the event type nor organizer has a destination calendar configured, the team members' destination calendars won't be used, resulting in no calendar events being created for those hosts.
